description: This file defines the 'Online' report model class within the Opencart admin module. It provides methods to retrieve online customer session records and their total count from the database, supporting filtering by IP and customer name.

classes.name: Online
classes.description: A model class for retrieving online customer session records and counts within the Opencart admin reporting module.

methods.name: getOnline
methods.description: Retrieves a list of customer online records, optionally filtered by IP address and customer name, with pagination support.

methods.name: getTotalOnline
methods.description: Retrieves the total count of online customer records, with optional filtering.
